origin: Trained locally on synthetic dry/native-limiter pairs, with no external datasets or pretrained weights
runtime: Offline NumPy initializer only; native scalar refinement and qualified preset export. No callback inference or native DSP change.
supported_profile: 1x hard fully wet fully linked single release, feed_forward true; no soft/ISP/true-peak/dual release. Explicit threshold[-20,0] and lookahead[0,20]ms; paired aligned raw f32 audio2–8s at44.1–192kHz with1–8channels/max4M interleaved samples. Validation coverage is smaller than the admitted domain.
acceptance: Native waveform relative RMS<=0.002, max absolute error<=0.01; sampled ambiguity rejection at>=10%release separation/best+0.001RMS; actual native sample ceiling check and different-callback preset reopen. Finite heuristic, not a global continuous identifiability guarantee.
remaining: Natural recorded material and independently set/calibrated tolerance/ambiguity coverage
Performance benefit over strong classical initialization must be assessed separately from synthetic fitting success
Other native limiter configurations, listening/user-reference acceptance, timing/memory and host/UI integration
Analog-limiter coloration and physical hardware matching are separate unimplemented requirements
